description_en: Retrieves the default drive for a specified user
description_zh: 获取指定用户的缺省空间
name: GetDefaultDrive

parameters.description_en: The user ID. This parameter is required when you use an AK but optional when you use an access token. If omitted, the ID of the user associated with the access token is used.
parameters.description_zh: 用户 id，AK 访问时必填，AccessToken 访问时可选（默认取 AccessToken 关联的用户 id）
parameters.help_en: The user ID. This parameter is required when you use an AK but optional when you use an access token. If omitted, the ID of the user associated with the access token is used
